summary: hub_hosttest.c, usb_interrupt_hosttest.c and msc_hosttest.c with eleven faults in private copies of rach2/sys/usb/core.c, hub.c, usb.c and msc.c; the test runs all three

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && cp tests/host/hub_hosttest.c tests/host/msc_hosttest.c tests/host/usb_interrupt_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/tests/host/ && for t in hub usb_interrupt msc; do ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc ${WORK}/t/tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest || exit; done
s=0; for t in hub_hosttest usb_interrupt_hosttest msc_hosttest; do ${WORK}/$t || { r=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] || s=$r; }; done; exit $s
